text.p: These are the highlights of the main Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro newspapers this morning.
GAZETA MERCANTIL
-- HSBC INVESTMENT WAS OF $929 MLN
Brazil's Central Bank bought up and exchanged the $929 million entering Brazil as a result of the takeover of Brazilian bank Bamerindus by HSBC last week.
-- MITSUI TO GET 40 PCT OF CAEMI CAPITAL

Metal and mining group Caemi is expected to conclude negotiations with Japan's Mitsui & Co Ltd by the end of the week to increase its capital by 40 percent and give Mitsui a 40-percent stake in Caemi in exchange for a $200 million capital injection.
-- ASEAN AND MERCOSUL DISCUSS COOPERATION
Asean Secretary General Ajit Singh is in Brazil on an official three day visit to discuss free trade between the Asean member states and Latin America's Mercosur free trade union.
FOLHA DE SAO PAULO
-- TORTURE AND DEATH TOPPLE TWO POLICE OFFICERS
Two Brazilian military police chiefs have been dismissed in connection with a video tape which shows 10 Sao Paulo police officers allegedly beating and killing civilians.
-- TRADE GAP ALREADY AMOUNTS TO $3 BLN
Brazil's trade gap in March should hit $1.03 billion, bringing the deficit in the three months to the end of March to $3.06 billion.
O GLOBO
-- CARDOSO TO SACK 50,000 IF REFORM IS NOT APPROVED
President Fernando Henrique Cardoso has threatened to sack 50,000 public workers if a civil service reform bill is not approved by Congress.
-- MANAUS COMBATS PROSTITUTION BY CLEANING UP STREETS

Authorities in the Amazonian city of Manaus are fighting child prostitution by removing homeless children from the city's streets rather than by investigating bars and nightclubs that promote child prostitution.
-- SAO PAULO POLICE CRIMINALS ACCUSED OF HIDEOUS CRIME
Sao Paulo police officers caught on video allegedly beating and killing civilians will await their trial in police custody and could be sentenced to at least 56 years in jail.
-- Reuters has not verified the stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 5074151))
